name: RuSafety
description: The widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) raises critical concerns about their safety, particularly in languages other than English. While recent research demonstrates that LLM security degrades outside English, safety in Russian remains largely underexplored. In this work, we introduce RuSafety, a curated dataset of 1,198 dangerous Russian prompts covering 14 commonly used safety scenarios. The dataset is derived from the multilingual XSafety benchmark through a multi-stage filtering and validation procedure.
